name: Luke Wilson
fields: Criminal Law · Civil / Tort Law · Family Law
bio: Founder and Editor-in-Chief of Legal Lens. Luke is an undergraduate studying Political Science at UCLA on a pre-law track, driven by a passion for advocacy, education, and empathy. He leads a team of student writers through the full publication process, from first draft to final piece.

name: Skyler Dias
bio: Skyler Dias is a history student at Contra Costa College with a deep interest in law and the American legal system. He has studied more Supreme Court cases than books read in his lifetime. Outside the classroom, he can be found running or eating out with friends.

name: Veen Saleh
fields: Business & Corporate Law · Environmental Law · Employment Law
bio: Veen Saleh is a first-year student at UCLA pursuing a path toward law, with a strong interest in environmental advocacy and sustainability. As a first-generation American and college student, she writes and researches on environmental challenges and equitable, sustainable solutions, drawing on public policy as a tool for change.

name: Anatalio Ubalde
fields: Intellectual Property Law · Environmental Law · Healthcare Law
bio: Anatalio Ubalde is a public policy student at Claremont McKenna College. He writes and researches on housing affordability, community development, and the sociopolitical forces shaping Latinx youth. His work is rooted in West Oakland, where he co-founded a youth-run nonprofit serving unhoused neighbors.

name: Camrynn Manento
bio: Camrynn is a Political Science undergraduate at UCLA with a minor in Public Affairs. She is drawn to the intersections of law and society, with a particular focus on criminal and immigration law. Her writing aims to make complex legal issues in her field engaging, accessible, and meaningful.
